description.value: The Six Mile Pub & Eatery holds the distinction of being British Columbia's oldest pub, operating continuously since 1855 in a historic two-storey building beside Millstream. The kitchen produces everything from artisan breads and fresh pastas to house-made sausages and honey sourced from their on-site apiary, with a strong emphasis on locally and ethically sourced ingredients. A riverside patio opens seasonally, making it a scenic and substantial stop for touring cyclists passing through the Colwood/Langford corridor.
